items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: I'd like to hear Buford on tuba and also Bill Moore... Who are they? Lawson Buford and Bill Moore, William Moore, and Boyd Cobbs. I mean all three of them are very good.

ctx.x: That's great. . . Good tuba, man. Good tuba, man. That boy, Kyle. I'd like to hear Buford on tuba and also Bill Moore, I mean if you want to play the record for me. Sure.
